description: Every source with vanilla's isProjectile flag: arrows, tridents, thrown items (snowballs, eggs, pearls, our own shrapnel), wither skulls, fireballs, the potato cannon. Deliberately excludes 'player' and 'mob' even though Quark's pickarang and IE turrets reuse those message ids for projectile hits - the LIVE flag (creativeengineering:projectile as computed, not this file) already gets those right per-hit; listing the bare id here would wrongly tag every punch as a projectile too.
